trans-unit.source: Here you can define the company and target group briefing which Sidekick should take into account.
Registered as a new installation. Connected tools had to be reconnected with the new address.
The key was not changed: the stored key cannot be used. Restore a backup, or give this installation a new key.
The key was replaced. This installation now identifies itself with the new key.
The key was changed, but NEOSidekick reports it as {0}. Open key management again to finish the change.
This installation is now registered under its current domain. Connected tools keep working.
A key change is still waiting for NEOSidekick. Reload this page until it is finished, then try again.
NEOSidekick did not report a registered domain for this installation. Reload this page and try again.
